ai_summary: Aeroflex Neu Limited, a material subsidiary of Aeroflex Enterprises Limited, has finalized the acquisition of a 51.01% controlling stake in Stilonn Valves and Controls Private Limited, making Stilonn its new subsidiary. This strategic move aims to establish an integrated platform for high-tech engineering solutions within the AI Infra and Data Centre sector, representing a material expansion into a rapidly growing market. The provided corporate disclosure is standard and does not indicate any immediate red flags.
